value.definition: the attributes Alan's daily upkeep habits earned on a day
how much of the transaction record is still unreviewed

invariants.statement: The backlog counted is a year's.
The intake the backlog is measured against is a month's.
The feed also sends the year's total.
No tile draws the year's total.
The tap opens Monarch filtered only where Monarch was not already running.

value.definition: how much of the weekly Claude allowance is spent and when more arrives

invariants.statement: Each reading here is drawn as a number rather than as a stoplight.
A reading here is the pool's rather than one account's.
How much of the allowance is spent and how long the allowance has left are two readings.

value.definition: what the block Alan is in costs him for each hour it runs

invariants.statement: The reading is the multiplier the block's safety and difficulty price it at.
The color this group draws is read with the surplus rather than off a scale.

value.definition: how far each of Alan's inboxes is from empty

invariants.statement: A daily inbox of at least a hundred readings is black rather than a reading gone missing.
An inbox at empty is blue.
The color any other reading takes is stated by that reading's own scale.

value.definition: how safe things are where Alan is

invariants.statement: The color reports where Alan is rather than whether Alan did well.
A level draws its figure at either end of its scale.
The tile draws that figure alone.

value.definition: how much of Alan's night the day has left him

invariants.statement: The reading is the hours the night had less the hours the day spent.

value.definition: whether the daily keeping of Alan and his surroundings is holding
how well the day served each of Alan's values

invariants.statement: Every value runs the same multiplier ladder and only its baseline differs.
A value's figure sums its personas' raw units rather than flooring each unit to a rung.

value.definition: how hard Alan's workstation is working

invariants.statement: Each reading here is drawn as a number rather than as a stoplight.
A reading here is the workstation's own rather than one process's.
The processor reading here is a share and the memory reading an amount.
A reading here is drawn in the unit its own readout names.
